climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A strip of land along the Columbia River in central Washington, between Chelan and Wenatchee, entirely within the Columbia Valley AVA. It has seven vineyards on about 117 acres. The name comes from a rocky stretch of river rapids.
